what_this_is: Every data-service route that appears as a literal in the app JavaScript, with the HTTP method used beside it and the function it sits in. Read out of the bundles; no data service was called.
caution: These are routes the CLIENT can build, not routes proven to exist or to be permitted. A route here is a lead, not evidence — nothing is verified until a real call is made and its effect confirmed. Methods are read from the nearest method literal and can be wrong where a config is assembled dynamically.
